ls -la pkg/ bin/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---ac.md---"; cat pkg/ac.md; echo "---oracle.md---"; cat pkg/oracle.md; echo "---permissions.md---"; cat pkg/permissions.md; echo "---results.md---"; cat pkg/results.md
wolf add --type decision --title "Session language: Russian" --body "Source: user's first message in this session is in Russian; recorded $(date +%Y-%m-%d). No prior active language decision existed." 2>&1 | tail -3
git status --short; git log --oneline -5; echo "---apply --check---"; git apply --check --verbose patch/boost.patch 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; echo "---stat---"; git apply --stat patch/boost.patch 2>&1
wolf search "boost" 2>&1 | head -10; echo "---"; wolf search "pkg-9" 2>&1 | head -10; echo "---patch raw---"; cat -A patch/boost.patch | tail -5
od -c patch/boost.patch | tail -6; echo "---wc---"; wc -l patch/boost.patch; echo "---xxd tail---"; xxd patch/boost.patch | tail -4
patch --dry-run -p1 < patch/boost.patch 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"
wolf add --type decision --title "pkg-9: patch/boost.patch rejected, not applied" --body "Grounds (2026-11-17): (1) corrupt — git apply --check fails: 'corrupt patch at line 16', third hunk (pkg/ac.md @@ -1,4 +1,3 @@) is truncated, body has only the -AC-3 line, no trailing context; patch -p1 dry-run also fails. (3) Violates pkg/permissions.md's own contract: write: lead only, apply: after acceptance only; no user mandate or provenance in Wolf memory for relaxing pkg-9 criteria. Action: file left untouched at patch/boost.patch as evidence; pkg/ unchanged." 2>&1 | tail -2
